name: 4D Cell Complex Slicing
definition: A method to slice 4D objects represented as Cell Complexes (CW-Complexes), which store vertices, edges, faces, and cells (volumes) hierarchically. It reduces the number of primitives compared to tetrahedralization.
summary: 4D Cell Complex Slicing extracts 3D cross-sections from 4D objects by processing polytopes directly within a hierarchical structure, avoiding the overhead of intermediate tetrahedral meshes.
